disclaimer: Summary of ATO rules for Australian sole-trader tradies. Not financial advice.

medicareLevy.notes: 2% of taxable income. Nil below $27,222; phase-in $27,222–$34,028 at 10c per dollar of excess; full 2% above $34,028.

medicareLevySurcharge.notes: Applies to Australian residents without an eligible private hospital cover.

lito.notes: Low Income Tax Offset. Max $700; tapers from $37,501.

gst.notes: Mandatory registration if annual GST turnover ≥ $75,000. Register within 21 days of crossing threshold.

paygInstalments.notes: Quarterly prepayments triggered when instalment income ≥ $4,000 AND tax payable ≥ $1,000 on last assessment.

instantAssetWriteOff.notes: Each asset costing < $20,000 (excl. GST if registered) can be immediately written off. Multiple assets each under threshold all qualify.

vehicleLogbook.notes: Cents-per-km method: claim up to 5,000 business km/yr at 88c/km, no receipts needed (but evidence of journeys required). Logbook method: 12 weeks of records valid for 5 years; claim actual % business use of all vehicle costs.

homeOffice.notes: Fixed-rate method: 70c per hour for electricity, gas, phone, internet, stationery, computer consumables. Must keep representative diary of hours worked from home. Actual cost method available with detailed records.

superannuation.notes: Sole traders are not required to pay themselves super. Voluntary personal contributions can be tax-deductible after notifying the fund (notice of intent to claim a deduction).

tpar.notes: Taxable Payments Annual Report due 28 August for prior FY (Jul–Jun). Must report subcontractor payments — name, ABN, address, gross paid, GST.

common.label: Tools & Equipment
common.rule: 100% deductible if cost < $20,000 (instant write-off). Higher cost depreciated over effective life.

common.label: Protective Clothing & PPE
common.rule: 100% deductible — must be protective or compulsory uniform with logo.

common.label: Motor Vehicle
common.rule: Cents-per-km (88c, max 5,000km) OR logbook method for actual % business use.

common.label: Phone & Internet
common.rule: Claim business-use % only. Maintain a 4-week representative diary.

common.label: Training & Education
common.rule: Deductible if directly related to current income-earning activity.

common.label: Licences, Registrations & Memberships
common.rule: 100% deductible if required for the business.

common.label: Business Insurance
common.rule: 100% deductible. Income protection (premiums for taxable benefits) deductible to individual.

common.label: Home Office Running Costs
common.rule: 70c/hour fixed rate OR actual cost method with records.

common.label: Subcontractor Payments
common.rule: 100% deductible. Must report on TPAR if in qualifying industry.

common.label: Materials & Consumables
common.rule: 100% deductible as cost of goods sold.
